# Specialpsykologer

Specialpsykologer (specialist psychologists) is a professional group at the center of a debate over who is legally and practically qualified to diagnose ADHD in Denmark. The group is discussed in the appendix to the ADHD 2024 annual report, which documents regional feedback on the diagnostic indicators used in the national ADHD database [^src1].

According to [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], Danish legislation permits Specialpsykologer to issue psychiatric diagnoses — as stated in the source material, "Der står i lovgivningen, at Specialpsykologer 'må stille psykiatriske diagnoser'" [^src1]. Region Sjælland's child and adolescent psychiatric service (SFR B&U-psyk) reports that it has "i mange år" (for many years) flagged it as inappropriate that Specialpsykologer's documented competencies were not included in the RKKP ADHD framework [^src1].

Region Sjælland points to a precedent within the national quality database system: RKKP Skizofreni (the schizophrenia quality database) has already included Specialpsykologer alongside Speciallæger (specialist physicians) in its diagnostic criteria, reportedly without requiring extra preparatory work [^src1]. Citing this precedent and the legal basis for Specialpsykologers' diagnostic authority, Region Sjælland has formally recommended that [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] be revised immediately to include Specialpsykologer in ADHD diagnosis [^src1]. The stated rationale is that including this qualified group would help resolve bottlenecks in the diagnostic process, as reflected in the entity's broader significance within the ADHD database's indicator framework.

This dispute sits within a larger context: the ADHD database's appendix compiles regional commentary from five Danish regions on their performance against various indicators, with several regions — including Region Sjælland — reporting registration problems, implementation challenges, and calls for indicator revisions [^src1].
